description: List per-scan usage rows (cost in micros, kind, scan id, timestamp). Use to attribute cost to specific scans or campaigns.

date_from.description: ISO 8601 datetime (with timezone offset), inclusive lower bound on the usage timestamp. Plain dates also work — the API normalises to UTC midnight.

date_to.description: ISO 8601 datetime (with offset), inclusive upper bound.

scan_id.description: Filter to one scan's cost rows.

name: list_usage
title: List Usage
